_comment: Business research lane (2026-10-21). Selected by a workflow template's "research_profile": "business" (core/research-profiles.js); never read by a biomedical template. Every evidence source here emits an identifier the citation gate grounds and the re-resolver checks: WEB (stored page snapshot), SEC (filing), WB (World Bank indicator), BLS / EUROSTAT / CENSUS / EIA (official statistics series, Evidence Desk), doi (OpenAlex). Vault and memory reads stay CONTEXT ONLY, as on the biomedical lane. Evidence Desk (2026-10-21): the scout's section is written by the Desk from the scout's records, without a model call, so the vault read-back moved to the analyst (a deterministic brief must never carry vault text). `requires` names derived inputs an entry needs (us_scope / eurostat_geo); `local_only` entries are skipped unless their fetcher is wired (Census / EIA need keys).

scout._comment: Company filings when the request names a company; otherwise skipped by the empty-args guard.
U.S. runs only. Series from config/business-series-map.json by industry.
European runs only (eurostat_geo is derived from country).
P2: skipped until CENSUS_API_KEY exists (the fetcher is not wired without it).
P2: skipped until EIA_API_KEY exists (the fetcher is not wired without it).

analyst._comment: Moved from the scout 2026-10-21: the scout is now the Evidence Desk's deterministic brief.
